messages:
deploybot: Release job started: rdlw-frontend v2.8.1 -> prod (canary 2 regions). Scheduled change window: 2024-10-12T20:00Z - 2024-10-12T22:00Z. /deploy rdlw-frontend v2.8.1
rebecca: FYI incident-4472 affecting eu-west1 just triggered, ops triage in progress. please hold any multi-region rollouts targeting EU until we know scope. :warning:
sam: confirming — incident-4472: degraded routing to eu-west1, some 5xxs. oncall is investigating, current ETA ~45m but could slip.
lucas: +1 hold. If we continue we risk cascading errors on canary. Recommend pause and either reschedule or run a strict one-zone canary outside eu-west1.
kai: can we do a partial squeeze? i.e., run canaries only in us-east/us-west with shortened observation (10m) and pin eu to previous version so we don't touch eu infra.
rebecca: prefer avoid changing plan mid-orbit unless safe. two options: 1) pause full rollout and reschedule window, 2) proceed with us-only canary + pin EU on v2.8.0 and enable immediate rollback policy. Thoughts?
sam: ops prefers option 1 unless the change only affects UI assets. Are there DB or infra migrations in this release?
kai: no migrations, it's runtime model routing tweak + front-end flag. No DB changes. Risk is higher in EU due to current instability.
rebecca: deploybot — can you pause the rollout and create a follow-up job with pinned EU? Also add an automatic rollback-on-5xx policy and shorten canary to 10m for US regions if we go that route.
deploybot: Acknowledged. Pausing job rdlw-frontend v2.8.1 (job_id: 0x8f3a). Suggested reschedule slots: 2024-10-12T23:30Z, 2024-10-13T01:00Z. New job creation template: 
```
/deploy rdlw-frontend v2.8.1 --canary-regions=us-east,us-west --canary-duration=10m --eu-pin=v2.8.0 --rollback-threshold=0.75
```
rebecca: OK. I like the template. Let's create a new job for midnight UTC (2024-10-12T23:30Z) and mark it as rescheduled from incident-4472. Add a note in the release notes: "rescheduled due to region incident; EU pinned to v2.8.0 until validation complete."
lucas: I'll add a short smoke test to the canary pipeline to check 200s for /health and /api/v1/model-route. If smoke fails, deploybot should abort and rollback.
sam: ops will keep incident channel updated. if ETA extends past 60m, we should cancel midnight slot and replan.
kai: also add a canary metric alert: error_rate > 0.5% for 2m -> abort. Command for deploybot config: 
```
deploybot update-policy --job 0x8f3a --abort-on-metric "error_rate>0.5%:2m" --rollback-threshold 0.75
```
rebecca: Sounds good. Rebecca -> creating reschedule ticket and updating release notes. tagging @oncall for midnight slot: sam can you confirm availability?
sam: i can cover the midnight slot but will handoff if incident persists. Please ping 30m before run.
rebecca: Reschedule confirmed: new job created 1729459000 (placeholder). Release notes updated with "Incident-4472: EU region pinned; rollout rescheduled to 2024-10-12T23:30Z UTC; canary reduced to 10m; abort/rollback policies applied." Closing this thread — follow-ups in #incidents and the reschedule ticket. :white_check_mark:
